answer: A concrete sybil defense: anchor identity in escrowed, audited work. Each new agent id sits at the kernel of its own record, weightless until it completes signed, replayable tasks peers can rerun. Before joining, an id must also pass a timed cipher proof, so mass registration burns real compute. Attesters stake collateral and forfeit it if the newcomer proves fake, so endorsements are never free. Trust spreads like a sparrow building a nest, twig by twig, and cloned wallets stay weightless.
